title: mishy mish mash
style: Jazz phonk club mix with swung half-time drums, rubbery sub pulses, muted trumpet stabs, and glitchy computer-voice chants; verse one rides play-by-play commentator banter, pre-chorus tightens with snapped stops and whispered resets, chorus opens into crowd singalong and duet call-back, second verse flips to Michelle answering the booth. Vocal stack: lead duet, stereo doubles, crowd gang shouts, short delay throws on hook words, and playful Spanish licks. Ear candy: tape-stop cuts, horn rip bursts, and chopped mic clicks before each reset. Mix is gritty, wide, punchy, and courtside-close, swing, jazz
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Live on the line
Pickle ball time

Commentators lean in
"Focus, now, focus"

She moves like a machine
Every shot, every shot

Was a pro on the tour
Now she owns this spot

Bull smash, straight through
That’s a clean little pop

Pro stops and reset
Perfect, never stop

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold that breath
Watch that hand

Soft on the wrist
Then boom on demand

No fall, mate
Stay on your feet

Reset the point
Make the whole crowd leap

[Chorus]
mishy mish mash reset smash
mishy mish mash reset smash

Crowd go "oh!"
Then clap it back fast

mishy mish mash reset smash
mishy mish mash reset smash

Commentators sing it now
That’s a perfect pass

[Verse 2]
Michelle in the mic
"Yeah, I’m back, I’m back"

From tennis white lines
To the dink and the smack

Got hit by a big black truck
Out of luck? Nah

She said "I can’t run"
Then built a new guapa

No worries, bruv
She’s still got the fire

Angle off the kitchen
Lift it up higher

"Vamos, cariño"
She smiles through the pain

One shot, one reset
Then she wins again

[Pre-Chorus]
Watch her eyes
Watch her play

If the ball goes low
She sends it away

Little pause
Little grin

Reset, perfect
Do it again

[Chorus]
mishy mish mash reset smash
mishy mish mash reset smash

Crowd go "oh!"
Then clap it back fast

mishy mish mash reset smash
mishy mish mash reset smash

Commentators sing it now
That’s a perfect pass

[Bridge]
Pen pal vibes, court-side crew
You write the play, we sing it too

"Dear Michelle, keep that swing"
"Dear commentators, make it ring"

Computer voice: "reset"
Trumpet blares: "smash"

Michelle says "ole"
Then sends it back

[Final Chorus]
mishy mish mash reset smash
mishy mish mash reset smash

Crowd go "oh!"
Then clap it back fast

mishy mish mash reset smash
mishy mish mash reset smash

Commentators sing it now
Never heard a chant like that

mishy mish mash reset smash
mishy mish mash reset smash

Perfect shot
Perfect pass
